notes.title: Public demo available NOW!
notes.content: [h2]Sands Of Hope is having a FREE playable Demo![/h2][p][/p][p]We're happy to announce that a public demo is available for you to [b]play now[/b], and that it will take part in the Steam's Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]This is your chance to take a first step into Hope's adventure. If you enjoy your time with the demo, we'd be so grateful if you [b]leave a review :)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you want to leave some feedback, please let us know your comments and suggestions [b]via e-mail with the subject "feedback"[/b], we'll appreciate it![/p][p][/p][p][i]contact@guatekestudios.com[/i][/p][p][/p]
